Definition: Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings
BiblicalUsage: Artaxerxes = "I will make the spoiled to boil: I will stir myself (in) winter"; 1) son and successor of Xerxes as emperor of Persia, 465-424 BC
